hypothesis: SEC 8-K item 1.01 (Material Definitive Agreement) filings for watchlist tickers in an established uptrend may produce positive 10-day forward returns as a new information family combining corporate catalyst event quality with price momentum confirmation.
change_summary: Probe-only: measured 10-day forward returns on watchlist tickers with 8-K item 1.01 events in late_strong window. No code was written or deployed.

calibration.surprise_note: 8-K 1.01 events showed clearly negative forward returns (mean -0.51%, hit 37.1%) in late_strong. No need to proceed to Gate 4 backtest. SEC 5.02 also failed three-window consistency test.

rejection_reason: 8-K item 1.01 shows clearly NEGATIVE 10-day forward returns in primary window (late_strong n=70, mean=-0.51%, hit=37.1%). Signal direction is opposite of hypothesis. Pre-Gate 4 failure: the probe disconfirmed the mechanism before any implementation was needed. SEC 8-K data as a standalone candidate-pool source for watchlist tickers is exhausted across item codes tested (1.01, 2.02, 5.02, 7.01, 8.01).
next_retry_requires: A genuinely independent new free-data source family (not SEC events, not OHLCV peer shocks, not FINRA)
New evidence that 8-K event type predicts direction positively across all three standard windows
Or: Form 4 insider buying cluster as alternative event source (not yet tried)
anti_repeat_rule: Do not retry SEC 8-K material agreement (item 1.01) or any other SEC 8-K item as a primary candidate-pool source for watchlist tickers without new structural evidence that event type predicts direction positively in all three standard windows. SEC leadership (5.02) fails old_thin.
notes: Probe-only experiment. No code written, no backtest run. docs/experiment_log.jsonl is an LFS pointer in this environment; full rejection details stored here in experiments/logs/.
